therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: protein degradation pathway disruption leading to multiple myeloma cell death
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: newly diagnosed multiple myeloma patients ineligible for transplant or postponing autologous stem cell transplant
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: response rate (stable disease through complete response)

results.effect_size: Overall response rate: 74% (37/50 patients with minimal response or better)
safety_signals: Bortezomib dose reductions required in 16% of patients
Dexamethasone dose reductions required in 28% of patients
results.dose_information: Bortezomib 1.6 mg/m2 IV weekly for 4 weeks followed by 1 week off (5-week cycles); Dexamethasone 40mg on day of and day after bortezomib (reduced to 20mg if not tolerated)
